arguments.content:
import os, glob, re

base = "workspace/unpacked"
print("=== SLIDE FILES ===")
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "ppt/slides/slide*.xml"))):
    print(os.path.basename(f))

print("\n=== SLIDE RELS FILES ===")
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "ppt/slides/_rels/*.rels"))):
    print("---", os.path.basename(f))
    with open(f, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        print(fh.read())

print("\n=== SLIDE LAYOUTS ===")
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "ppt/slideLayouts/*.xml"))):
    print(os.path.basename(f))

print("\n=== NOTES SLIDES ===")
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "ppt/notesSlides/*.xml"))):
    print(os.path.basename(f))

print("\n=== presentation.xml sldIdLst ===")
with open(os.path.join(base, "ppt/presentation.xml"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    content = fh.read()
m = re.search(r"<p:sldIdLst>.*?</p:sldIdLst>", content, re.S)
print(m.group(0) if m else "(not found)")

print("\n=== presentation.xml sldSz ===")
m = re.search(r"<p:sldSz[^/]*/>", content)
print(m.group(0) if m else "(not found)")

import os

base = "workspace/unpacked"
for name in ["ppt/slides/slide1.xml", "ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml"]:
    print(f"===== {name} =====")
    with open(os.path.join(base, name), "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        print(fh.read())
    print()

import os, re

base = "workspace/unpacked"
with open(os.path.join(base, "ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    master = fh.read()

print("=== MASTER: ctrTitle placeholder ===")
m = re.search(r"<p:sp>.*?<p:ph type=\"ctrTitle\".*?</p:sp>", master, re.S)
print(m.group(0) if m else "(none)")

print("\n=== MASTER: title placeholder ===")
m = re.search(r"<p:sp>.*?<p:ph type=\"title\".*?</p:sp>", master, re.S)
print(m.group(0) if m else "(none)")

print("\n=== MASTER: background ===")
m = re.search(r"<p:bg>.*?</p:bg>", master, re.S)
print(m.group(0) if m else "(none)")

print("\n=== MASTER: first 1500 chars ===")
print(master[:1500])

import os

base = "workspace/unpacked"

slide6 = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main" xmlns:m="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/math" xmlns:a14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2010/main" showMasterSp="1" showMasterPhAnim="1">
  <p:cSld>
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr>
        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>
        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>
        <p:nvPr/>
      </p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr>
        <a:xfrm>
          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>
          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>
        </a:xfrm>
      </p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="96" name="Title 1"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>
          <p:nvPr>
            <p:ph type="ctrTitle"/>
          </p:nvPr>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr/>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr defTabSz="242315">
              <a:defRPr sz="4000"/>
            </a:pPr>
            <a:r>
              <a:t>Thank you for your attention</a:t>
            </a:r>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="97" name="Subtitle 2"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>
          <p:nvPr>
            <p:ph type="subTitle" sz="quarter" idx="1"/>
          </p:nvPr>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr/>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p/>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr>
    <a:masterClrMapping/>
  </p:clrMapOvr>
  <p:transition xmlns:p14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main" spd="med" advClick="1"/>
</p:sld>
"""

# 1. Create the slide file
with open(os.path.join(base, "ppt/slides/slide6.xml"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(slide6)

# 2. Create slide relationships file (references slideLayout1 like slide1)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(base, "ppt/slides/_rels"), exist_ok=True)
rels6 = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>
<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout" Target="../slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml"/>
</Relationships>
"""
with open(os.path.join(base, "ppt/slides/_rels/slide6.xml.rels"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(rels6)

# 3. Update [Content_Types].xml
ct_path = os.path.join(base, "[Content_Types].xml")
with open(ct_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    ct = fh.read()
assert '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml"' in ct
override6 = '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
assert "</Types>" in ct
ct = ct.replace("</Types>", override6 + "\n</Types>")
with open(ct_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(ct)

# 4. Update ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels
prels_path = os.path.join(base, "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
with open(prels_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    prels = fh.read()
assert 'Target="slides/slide5.xml"' in prels
rel6 = '<Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>'
assert "</Relationships>" in prels
prels = prels.replace("</Relationships>", "  " + rel6 + "\n</Relationships>")
with open(prels_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(prels)

# 5. Update ppt/presentation.xml sldIdLst
pres_path = os.path.join(base, "ppt/presentation.xml")
with open(pres_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    pres = fh.read()
assert '<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>' in pres
sldid6 = '    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>'
pres = pres.replace('</p:sldIdLst>', sldid6 + "\n  </p:sldIdLst>")
with open(pres_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(pres)

print("All edits applied.")
